item.title: Inside the Ohka Manned Missile
item.description: During the last years of WWII, as Allied forces advanced steadily across the Pacific, Japan turned to increasingly unconventional methods to slow the tide of the war. item.title: Inside the B-17 Flying Fortress
item.description: During the early years of World War II, the Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress emerged as the centerpiece of the United States’ strategic bombing campaign over Europe.
